visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian woman with short dark hair stands on an urban sidewalk, wearing a pink-and-white striped sweater and black leather skirt. She holds up an iPhone displaying Google Maps and points at the viewer with an expressive, slightly teasing facial expression. Parked scooters and a red brick wall are visible in the background under daylight. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up screen recording of the iPhone. A user's finger taps the blue location dot on the map interface, opening a menu. The finger then selects "Save parking," which places a red pin on the map labeled "You parked here," showing detailed street information for the current location. (3) The woman is back on screen, standing near a busier street with cars and green trees. She continues speaking enthusiastically, holding her phone as a prop to reinforce her message. The lighting is bright and natural, reflecting an outdoor setting with clearly visible pedestrian walkways and parked motorcycles. (4) Another screen recording shows the "Saved parking" card being tapped again. The Google Maps interface automatically calculates a walking route from the user's current location back to the saved parking spot, demonstrating the ease of navigation with a blue line and estimated time on the map. (5) The woman concludes her demonstration, looking into the lens with a playful smirk and tilting her head. The background shows the city sidewalk with more parked motorbikes and storefronts in the distance, maintaining a consistent urban atmosphere throughout the instructional clip.
